title: Criteria/matrix mismatch
text: Criteria/matrix mismatch: Use Case 2 requires each revision's date and the date the current version became active, but AC7 requires only a version, evidence, and revision-history entry. Add the date requirements to the acceptance contract so the use case is testable.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in 4f24a57, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Spec PR counted in scope: Ronda reviews spec PRs and reports no findings. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
